description: This header file defines several ViewModel classes used for design-time data in a Windows UI application, specifically for a unit converter. These classes are intended for use in the Visual Studio designer and Blend to provide semi-realistic data for UI controls during development.

classes.name: CategoryViewModel
classes.description: A ViewModel representing a category in the unit converter, with properties for name and visibility, used for design-time data.

classes.name: UnitViewModel
classes.description: A ViewModel representing a unit with a name and abbreviation, used for design-time data.

classes.name: UnitConverterSupplementaryResultViewModel
classes.description: A ViewModel for displaying supplementary conversion results, including value and associated unit.

classes.name: UnitConverterViewModel
classes.description: The main ViewModel for the unit converter, holding collections of categories, units, and supplementary results, initialized with sample data for design purposes.

methods.name: CategoryViewModel
methods.description: Constructor initializing category name and visibility.

methods.name: UnitViewModel
methods.description: Constructor initializing unit name and abbreviation.

methods.name: UnitConverterSupplementaryResultViewModel
methods.description: Constructor initializing value, unit, and abbreviation.

methods.name: UnitConverterViewModel
methods.description: Constructor initializing sample data for categories, units, and supplementary results.
